conclusion: Low overlap between RepTime-associated TD lists and RepWatchForum TDs is expected. RepTime does not run a native TD program and generally points at older Western-facing lists (RWI, RepGeek, RWG). RepWatchForum runs a separate vetting program that includes Korean and Chinese-facing networks. Absence from RWI or RepGeek is not by itself a negative. Appearance on one TD list is not by itself high confidence.
vettingDifferences: RepTime: no native TD program; relies on external forum lists.
RepWatchForum: formal program with provisionary periods, moderator test purchases, and participation expectations.
RWF giveaways and promotional posts stay in independence group rwf rather than counting as extra confirmation.
demographicNotes: RepTime-associated lists skew toward long English-language websites and traditional catalog sourcing.
RepWatchForum includes newer independent sellers, 1688Time/ChinaTime networks, and modding/custom builders.
incentiveNotes: RWF seller participation and sponsored giveaways are community-commercial relationships, not automatic trust reductions.
Evidence that originates entirely inside one forum remains one ecosystem.
